issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync on hot stack-trace path with no cache and no try/catch
issues.detail: getSourceMap fires per stack frame during error serialization, doing existsSync + readFileSync (plus a second read inside convert-source-map) with no memoization. On noisy runs this re-reads the same files repeatedly. readFileSync can also throw (EACCES, EISDIR, race), which would kill error reporting. Cache by file path and wrap in try/catch.

issues.description: Returning '{}' as a fake source map silently masks missing/broken map files
issues.detail: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns the literal string '{}' when the referenced map file is absent, producing a valid-but-empty SourceMap. Downstream consumers cannot distinguish a missing map from a broken sourceMappingURL. Return undefined/null and let the caller decide, or log at debug; do not lie to the parser.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) change in DecodedMap lacks unit test and stated preconditions
issues.detail: The argument-order flip is correct per sourcemap spec (resolve sources against the map's dirname), but DecodedMap is shared utility code with no precondition on `from` (file path vs URL vs directory) and no direct unit test. Only a snapshot in test/cli covers it. Add a packages/utils unit test for resolvedSources and prefer path.dirname(from) to make intent explicit.

issues.description: Mixing node:path with pathe and conflating predicates in getSourceMap branch
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from pathe; the new code reaches for node:path with no reason. Also `!mod?.transformResult && existsSync(file)` conflates 'externalized module' with 'file exists', relying on undocumented Vite folklore. Extract isExternalModule + fileExists and stick with pathe for consistency.

issues.description: Helpers belong in packages/utils/src/source-map, not test-run.ts
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile is a stateless (code, filePath) -> SourceMap transform with no relationship to test-run orchestration. Co-locate it with DecodedMap in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts so the source-map plumbing lives in one place.

issues.description: New convert-source-map dependency duplicates capability already in the tree
issues.detail: The repo already depends on @jridgewell/trace-mapping and ships DecodedMap. convert-source-map is essentially a sourceMappingURL regex plus a file read — roughly 30 lines in-tree. Measure the win before taking a new runtime dep and matching @types.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the fix is real and targeted but lands under-rigorous. Three load-bearing concerns are unanimous: synchronous readFileSync on the per-frame error path with no cache or try/catch, the '{}' fallback that lies to convert-source-map about missing maps, and a DecodedMap resolve() semantics change with no direct unit test in packages/utils. Secondary concerns include mixing pathe with node:path, conflated external-module predicate, misplaced helpers, and an arguably redundant convert-source-map dependency. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK before landing — tighten the screws on the hot path and add a utility-level test.
